title: Bali: Temples & Terraces
summary: Ubud's terraced hills, a sunrise volcano climb, and a coastline with quieter corners — built for travelers who want more than the beach clubs.
highlights: Tegalalang's rice terraces at first light

itinerary.title: Arrive in Ubud
itinerary.description: Settle into a rice-terrace villa, no plans for the first day.

itinerary.title: Mount Batur sunrise
itinerary.description: A pre-dawn trek up the volcano, breakfast at the summit.

itinerary.title: Rice terraces & cooking class
itinerary.description: Tegalalang at first light, then a hands-on Balinese cooking class.

itinerary.title: Temples day
itinerary.description: A guided visit to Tirta Empul and a lesser-visited water temple.

itinerary.title: The south coast
itinerary.description: Relocate to the coast for two nights, ending at Uluwatu for sunset.

itinerary.title: Depart Bali
itinerary.description: A final morning before your transfer to the airport.

included: 7 nights across an Ubud villa & coastal resort
The Mount Batur trek and cooking class
